name: Better Stack
description: Integrates Better Stack with Mattermost: incident alerts, on-call schedules, monitor status, and slash commands.

sections.title: Webhook URL
sections.subtitle: Copy this URL into Better Stack as the webhook destination.

settings.help_text: The API token used to interact with the Better Stack Uptime API (on-call schedules, incidents).
The ID of the Mattermost channel where incident alerts will be posted. Find the channel ID via Mattermost > Channel Settings > Copy Channel ID.
A unique secret token embedded in the webhook URL path. Use the Regenerate button to rotate the token — you must then update the URL in Better Stack.
settings.regenerate_help_text: Regenerating invalidates the current webhook URL. Update the URL in Better Stack afterwards.

settings.help_text: If set together with a password, incoming webhooks must use HTTP Basic Auth. Leave empty to rely on the secret token URL alone.
If set together with a username, incoming webhooks must use HTTP Basic Auth. Leave empty to rely on the secret token URL alone.
When enabled, posts the current on-call roster to the alert channel every morning at 08:00 CET/CEST (Europe/Stockholm time), regardless of whether the on-call person has changed.
